description: Airtel, Vodafone Idea, and Jio offer multiple affordable prepaid plans that allow customers to keep their SIM active around the year. Airtel customers can purchase a combination of prepaid plans with different validity periods, allowing them to keep their SIM card active. For reference, you can purchase the Rs. 199 recharge pack 13 times, which offers a validity of 28 days each time. By spending a total of Rs. 2,587, you can keep your Airtel SIM active for 364 days. Jio offers various voice-only recharge plans that allow users to keep their SIM card active. The most affordable voice-only pack costs Rs. 147, offering unlimited calling and 22 days of validity. For a year, you will pay a total of Rs. 2,440.
title: Cheapest Recharge to Keep Your SIM Active for a Year: Jio vs Airtel vs Vi

description: Wi-Fi speakers offer more than wireless music playback, with features such as multi-room audio, voice controls and support for popular streaming services. The Apple HomePod (2nd Gen) is a good fit for those using Apple devices, while the Amazon Echo Studio and Samsung Music Studio 5 offer Alexa integration. The Sonos Era 300 supports Dolby Atmos Music, and the JBL Authentics 200 works with both Alexa and Google Assistant. These five speakers are available in India across different price ranges.
title: Best Wi-Fi Speakers in India: Top Picks From Apple, Sonos, JBL and More

description: OTT plans are a great add-on for those interested in extracting the maximum value from the mobile recharge plans. These value-added subscriptions are available across numerous prepaid plans across operators. We take a look at the best ones available which offer access to a variety of OTT apps.
title: Jio vs Airtel vs Vi: Best Prepaid Plans with OTT Benefits Compared

description: Air purifiers have become an essential appliance in many Indian households, particularly in cities where dust, allergens and fluctuating air quality remain a concern throughout the year. This is especially true in North India, where PM2.5 levels have been running high in recent days, with Delhi and neighbouring cities among the worst affected. Brands such as Dyson, Philips and Xiaomi offer air purifiers across different price segments, but buyers on a tighter budget also have several options to consider. With multiple models available under Rs. 12,000, choosing the right one depends on factors such as filtration technology, room coverage, airflow, noise levels, smart features and filter replacement costs.
title: Best Air Purifiers Under Rs. 12,000 in India

description: If you are planning to upgrade to a smartphone with 512GB of storage, there are many options worth considering across different price segments. Here are some of the best smartphones with 512GB of storage that you can buy in India, including the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, iPhone 18 Pro Max, Xiaomi 17T, OnePlus 15R, and Google Pixel 11 Pro XL.
title: Best Smartphones With 512GB Storage in India: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, iPhone 18 Pro Max, More

description: Oppo is reportedly developing three devices, including a wide-screen foldable with a 2nm Snapdragon chipset and a 200-megapixel camera. A second handset could feature a 16:9 display, a MediaTek Dimensity 9-series processor and another 200-megapixel camera. The third device is described as a pocket-sized gimbal camera that may launch by the end of 2026. The leak follows reports that Oppo has shelved the Find X10 Ultra and could reuse some of its planned hardware in the Find X11 Pro Max.
title: Oppo May Expand Product Lineup With New Foldable Phone and Gimbal Camera

description: Xiaomi’s Redmi 17C 5G is nearly identical to the Redmi 15C it replaces. The phone offers nothing different aside from a new faux-leather finish, which aims to make it appear a bit upmarket. All of its underlying hardware remains similar to the older Redmi 15C, which will still be available until stocks last. With a new colourway and higher price tag, does Redmi 17C 5G make any sense? Read on to find out!
title: Redmi 17C 5G Review: Same Phone, New Price

description: WhatsApp does not allow users to schedule messages directly from the app. However, there are other methods that one can use to schedule WhatsApp messages. iPhone users can use Apple’s built-in Shortcuts app to schedule automated messages for specific contacts and times of the day. On the other hand, Android users can use third-party services to schedule WhatsApp messages. If you want to wish your friend or colleague a happy birthday but you can not stay up till midnight, you can simply schedule a WhatsApp message using one of the methods mentioned below. Similarly, early morning texts can be scheduled the night before. You can also avoid messaging your colleagues at odd times by simply scheduling a WhatsApp message for your working hours. The functionality is also beneficial, as it can reduce the chances of you forgetting to send an important message.
title: How to Schedule WhatsApp Messages: A Step-by-Step Guide
